assumptions.assumption: The average number of addresses per city is taken over cities that have at least one address (those appearing in the address table), not over every row in the city table.
Ties at 10th place are broken arbitrarily, as the request allows.

alternatives.interpretation: The average per city is taken over all cities in the city table, including cities with no addresses.
